title: content-safety-decision.v1
description: Content safety decision from the persistence guard to the owning semantic port. Only accepted supplies bytes to a writer. Rejected content produces no semantic payload. Additive redacted diagnostics are allowed; no rejected payload metadata is additive.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Additive redacted diagnostics are allowed; no rejected payload metadata is additive.

source_record_id.description: Identity of the source record evaluated by this guard.

policy_version.description: Version of the content-safety-policy.v1 under which this decision was made.

profile.description: Named boundary profile applied from the policy's boundary_profiles.

normalized_record_digest.description: Digest of the normalized record bytes. Present only when decision_code is accepted; absent for any rejection.

decision_code.description: Stable decision code. Only accepted authorizes a semantic write. Rejected codes carry no payload bytes or content-derived hashes.
